label: SDK Client Authentication (PasswordAuthenticator, RBAC connection)
type: the client-connection-establishment concern of how the SDK process proves its identity to the cluster (typically PasswordAuthenticator against Server RBAC, since Server 5.0) - a property of the client library's connection setup, distinct from sdk:certificate-authentication (the X.509 variant) and from the server-side rbac-role:role/privilege model itself
note: Minted in howtos/sdk-authentication.json (a round-3/4 pre-gate file - its two relations here carry the link-boundary evidence artifact, see round 30's finding) and reused with a clean, quotable relation in project-docs/migrating-sdk-code-to-3.n.json (requiresCapability version:server-5-0).
